933 E 48** Street Type 1 Narrative

The applicant is seeking a Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment in order to convert the existing grade
level garage space into living space and establish a second dwelling unit in the existing 1% story
brick building. There will be no additions to the building and the building will follow all existing
setbacks. In addition, this Type 1 amendment includes relief in the nature of a Variation (§17-
13-1101-C) to reduce the off-street parking requirement by two spaces from two (2) to zero (0),
in accordance with Section 17-13-0303-D of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance.

Proposed Zoning: RT4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District
Lot Area: 6,186 Square Feet

Existing Number of Dwelling Units: One (2nd Floor)

Proposed Number of Dwelling Units: Two (1st and 2nd Floors)

Proposed Floor Area: 3,862.76 Square Feet

Proposed Off-street Parking: Zero (0)

Proposed Setbacks: Existing

Proposed Building Height: Existing

*Seeking all relief as needed as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code for the attached plans
